fa7bddc0518fd2488487.en: The Penghu District Public Prosecutor's Office received a report that the Kaohsiung "○Hongsheng" (hereinafter referred to as the "Hong" ship) used the fishery power oil discount approved by the government, and there was a considerable profit margin. The fishery power oil was fraudulently obtained by forging the voyage recorder (VDR) tracks, which made huge profits. The offence was very vicious and the circumstances were serious. The case was jointly investigated by the Penghu District Public Prosecutor's Office Zhongshu Lin Jiyin, who commanded the Penghu Detection and Defense Branch of the Coast Guard Branch and the Seventh Shore Patrol of the Golden Horse Pen Branch. After several months of investigation, it was determined that the captain of the "Hong" ship purchased a total of 62 fishery power oil discounts from CNPC Penghu Ma Gong Fishing Boat Filling Station from October 10, 112 to February 1, 115 with false operating hours. After investigation, the cumulative oil volume of abnormal track hours was 1,573,425 liters, and the overflow subsidy amounted to NT $4,382,295, which implicated Article 339 of the Criminal Law.
